book.name: Mak
book.title: God ol wai ol na tongwo ha i Mak bol engwo dimia

content: Sabat haung Yisas yal ta aling kebir engwo awai ol tongwo ha
Ena Yisas ha maing oo ala hon ongure, yal ta aling kebir engwo mongwi.
Ena ari tau Yisas Lo ana holo holo isusu olangwo irai ha di mere si tenamna di han mongwi. Molere, Yisas Sabat haung awai ol tenam mo, tekinam mo, dire kwi han mongwi.
Mongure, Yisas aling kebir engwo yal i yu ditongwi, “Ni aire u gumana holiya wo.”
Yu direre, ari hobi yu ditongwi, “Lo ana holo holo talwa dungwo pine? Sabat habang nibil panangwo awai ol to dim mo, ol gogo dal to dime? Ari aki di to dim mo, si golo dime?”
Yu dimba, arihobi pir uning si mongwi. Pir uning si mole nona pangure, Yisas yong ki engwi. Embawe, miling pungwi. Pirere, yu ditongwi, “Ni ani sine do.” Dungure, yali sine dungure, aling wai dungwi.
Ena yu ongure, Perisi yalhobi ere mena pirere, Herot gamahobo wa dungwi. Wa dure mongwo i tibi olere, Yisas si golala dire ha hol albe engwi.
Ari tabin bir weni nir digan bina u ku bongwo ha
Ena Yisas grang wine ongwo hobi kina ere Galili nir digan ongwi. Ongure, ari tabin bir weni doling bol ongwi. Galili ari ungure,
Yudia ari ungure, Yerusalem ari ungure, Idumia ari ungure, Yodan nir bina hoibi holbani ari ungure, Taiya ari ungure, Saidon ari ungwi. Ena Yisas tal ongwo i ari hobi ha pirere, ungwi.

Urere, pi Yisas mongwo bani ongwi. Ongure, Yisas awai ol tongure, nibil pangwo hobi Yisas gaung arala dire wara kengwi. Te kwia nigi dongwo yong sina mongwo hobi iwe, Yisas gumang hanere, nin yare habilai sire gala dire yu dungwi, “Ni God wang monua.” Yu dungure, Yisas ha di yulang bole yu ditongwi, “Na hana dal tibi olekio.” Ena ari taporal u yobilema dire, Yisas grang wine ongwo hobi yu ditongwi, “Ari tabin bir weni u molere, na egerangwo pamia, sipi bolimbani monamna, i mala wo.” Dungure, sipi i mala ungure, Yisas pi bolimbani ami di mongwi.
Aposel hobi haang
Ena Yisas sipi pisolere, ere mena pire pi hamen hul ta ongwi.
Pi molere, honagi ari tau irala dire, gala di ku bongwi. Ena yalhobi u tabin sungure, ari ana holo holo kebena sutani i tibi olungwi.
Olere, “Ni yalhobi na gamnahobo weni monia, ni bai nu si olgere, ha maing ditere, kwia nigi dongwo si doling i olanua,” ditongwi.
Ena i tibi olungwo yalhobi ta haang Saimon haang hon Pita engwi.
Te ta Yems, ta Yon, yasuri Sebedi wang mongwi.

Mongure, haang hon Boanesis, haang iwe. Yui ha hamen guru yal momia. Te ta Endru, ta Pilip, ta Batolomyu, ta Matyu, ta Tomas, ta Yems momia. Yems iwe, yal Alpias wang mongwi. Te ta Tadias, ta miling olba sungwo yal Saimon mongwi.
Te ta Yudas, Yisas bai tal sungwo yal yaliwe, Keriot ganba hong yal mongwi. Ena i tibi olere, Yisas ere malgi ongwi.
Arihobi Yisas kwia singaba Bielsebul yulang ire honagi omua dungwo ha
Ena, Yisas grang wine ongwo hobi kina homena nerala dire omba, ari tabin bir weni u ku bongure ta nekungwi.
Ena yu ongure, algi tani yalhobi pungwi. Pirere, han holala dire urere, “Yali kraungi dima hano,” dungwi.
Ena Lo krehaman ha kene ongwo yal tau Yerusalem molere, ya ungwi. Urere, yu ditongwi, “Kwia nigi dongwo singaba mol tongwo yali haang Bielsebul yulang tongure, irere, kwia si doling i mena olimua.”
Yu dungure, Yisas pungwi. Pirere, “Ni yalhobi para wio” ditongwi. Ena ungure, Yisas ha bangi biire yu di engwi, “Seten nin molere, talongure nin si hobale olame?
Ari ganba banta sina sikira dire, kura bole, u susu namia.
Te irang aang hobi kina kura bole, gumang nin nin dinangwo, u susu namia. Te Seten nin nin ebir sire, si doling i ole tenangwo, nimni ta molkinamia.
Yal iwe, ere yu u susu nangwo pamua.
“Te nona pangwo yal ta monangure, yal ta oo kepangwo ala pirere, bona gana kuni inamo? Ta ikinama. Homa pi nona pangwo yal i kulere, kebering aling han sire, emgi ala pire bona gana inamua.”
“Ena yal tau tal nigi dongwo maing maing olere, gaung ha sire, onangwo, pring panangwo iwe, God nin kri di olangwo pamia.
Te, God Kwiang gaung ha si tenangwo iwe, pring hawo ya di panangwo bani panamia. Na ha weni kara di ni teiya ogolo piro.”
Ena kwia nigi dongwo yong sina momua ditomiraya, ha bangi biire ditongwi.
Yisas aang ebering hobi kina gala dungwo ha
Ena ditongwo habang iwe, Yisas ebering ya, aang hobi u maini mongwi.

Molere, “Yisas wo, dito,” dire gala dungwi. Gala dungure, ari taporal Yisas mongwo bani uku bole, yobile i sina olungwi. Olere yu ditongwi, “Pino. Nimai ebin hobi irai u maini molere, ni gala dimia wiya po.”
Dungure, yali aire, ari mongwo hobi han wabo dire, yu ditongwi.
“Namine ebina ara mongwo han dine?
God grang wine onga yalhobi iwe, namine ebina keunambi muru weni monua,” dungwi.
